Test Steps: Verify employee can successfully Punch In from Dashboard
Test Data: 1. Log in as Employee 2. Navigate to Dashboard/Attendance 3. Click 'Punch In' button
Date of execution: System records Punch In time and status updates to 'Working'.

Test Steps: Verify validation when attempting to Punch In when already punched in
Test Data: 1. Click 'Punch In' 2. Attempt to click 'Punch In' again without punching out
Date of execution: System disables 'Punch In' button or shows 'Already punched in' error.

Test Steps: Verify Late Mark is applied if Punch In is after grace period
Test Data: 1. Wait for shift start time + grace period (e.g., 9:15 AM) 2. Click 'Punch In'
Date of execution: Punch In is successful, but day is flagged with a 'Late In' marker.

Test Steps: Verify Geo-Fencing / IP restrictions for Punch In
Test Data: 1. Connect to non-office network / remote IP 2. Click 'Punch In'
Date of execution: System prevents Punch In and displays 'Unauthorized IP/Location' error.

Test Steps: Verify employee on approved Leave cannot Punch In
Test Data:
1. Apply and get approval for Leave today 
2. Attempt to Punch In
Date of execution: System blocks Punch In and shows 'You are on leave today'.

Test Steps: Verify employee can successfully Punch Out
Test Data: 1. Log in as Punched-In Employee 2. Click 'Punch Out'
Date of execution: System records Punch Out time, calculates total hours, and status updates.

Test Steps: Verify early Punch Out is flagged correctly
Test Data: 1. Punch In 2. Punch Out before completing standard shift hours (e.g., 8 hours)
Date of execution: Punch Out succeeds, but day is flagged as 'Early Go' or 'Half Day'.

Test Steps: Verify validation when attempting to Punch Out without Punching In
Test Data: 1. Log in directly without Punching In 2. Attempt to trigger Punch Out API
Date of execution: System returns error 'Cannot punch out without active punch in'.

Test Steps: Verify multiple Punch In/Out in a single day (Break tracking)
Test Data: 1. Punch In 2. Punch Out (Lunch) 3. Punch In again 4. Punch Out (End of Day)
Date of execution: System accurately records all time logs and calculates net working hours excluding breaks.

Test Steps: Verify system handles missed Punch Out (Auto-Checkout)
Test Data: 1. Punch In 2. Do not Punch Out until next calendar day
Date of execution: System flags entry as 'Missed Punch' or auto-checkouts at midnight.

Test Steps: Verify system auto-marks Absent for no-shows
Test Data: 1. Do not Punch In for the entire shift day 2. Check attendance log next day
Date of execution: System automatically marks the previous day as 'Absent' in records.

Test Steps: Verify Employee can apply for Attendance Regularization
Test Data: 1. Go to Attendance History 2. Select a 'Missed Punch' day 3. Click 'Regularize' 4. Fill reason & correct time 5. Submit
Date of execution: Request is submitted, status shows 'Pending Approval'.

Test Steps: Verify validation for applying regularization for future dates
Test Data: 1. Open Regularization form 2. Select a future date
Date of execution: System restricts selection of future dates in the calendar.

Test Steps: Verify validation for applying regularization on approved Leave days
Test Data: 1. Select a day marked as Leave 2. Attempt to apply regularization
Date of execution: System shows error 'Cannot regularize on an approved leave day'.

Test Steps: Verify Manager can view pending Regularization requests
Test Data: 1. Log in as Manager 2. Navigate to Approvals > Attendance
Date of execution: List shows all pending regularization requests from reportees.

Test Steps: Verify Manager can approve Regularization
Test Data: 1. Open pending request 2. Click 'Approve'
Date of execution: Request is approved, and employee's attendance record is updated with corrected time.

Test Steps: Verify Manager can reject Regularization
Test Data: 1. Open pending request 2. Click 'Reject' 3. Enter remark
Date of execution: Request is rejected, and original attendance anomaly (e.g., Absent) remains.

Test Steps: Verify total working hours calculation logic
Test Data: 1. Punch In at 09:00 2. Punch Out at 18:00
Date of execution: System calculates exactly 9h 00m of working time.

Test Steps: Verify Overtime calculation if hours exceed shift duration
Test Data: 1. Punch In at 09:00 2. Punch Out at 21:00 (Shift = 9hrs)
Date of execution: System logs 9 hours as regular and 3 hours as Overtime (OT).

Test Steps: Verify Employee can view their Monthly Calendar
Test Data: 1. Log in as Employee 2. Go to Attendance Calendar
Date of execution: Calendar loads showing color-coded Present/Absent/Leave/Holidays.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can view all employees' attendance for today
Test Data: 1. Log in as Admin 2. Go to Daily Attendance Report
Date of execution: Data table displays real-time Punch In status of all active employees.

Test Steps: Verify filtering attendance by Date Range
Test Data: 1. Admin goes to Attendance Reports 2. Selects Start Date: 1st, End Date: 15th 3. Search
Date of execution: Table updates to show records strictly within the selected dates.

Test Steps: Verify filtering attendance by Department
Test Data: 1. Admin selects 'Sales' from Department dropdown
Date of execution: Only attendance records of Sales employees are displayed.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can Export attendance report to CSV/Excel
Test Data: 1. Go to Attendance Report 2. Click 'Export to CSV'
Date of execution: File downloads successfully containing accurate data from the view.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can Bulk Import attendance logs (from Biometric)
Test Data: 1. Go to Import Attendance 2. Upload valid CSV file 3. Submit
Date of execution: Records are imported and mapped correctly to respective employees.

Test Steps: Verify validation when Bulk Importing invalid CSV file
Test Data: 1. Go to Import Attendance 2. Upload CSV with missing columns/invalid formats
Date of execution: System rejects upload and lists row-level errors for correction.

Test Steps: Verify Punching In on a declared Public Holiday
Test Data: 1. Attempt to Punch In on a calendar holiday
Date of execution: Depends on policy: System may flag as 'Holiday OT' or block punch.

Test Steps: Verify SQL Injection in Regularization Reason
Test Data: 1. Apply for Regularization 2. Enter SQL payload in reason
Date of execution: System sanitizes the string and saves without executing queries.

Test Steps: Verify API tampering for Punch Out time
Test Data: 1. Intercept Punch Out API call 2. Modify timestamp parameter to earlier time
Date of execution: Backend validates timestamp with server time and rejects spoofed time.

Test Steps: Verify timezone handling for remote employees
Test Data: 1. Employee logs in from GMT-5 timezone 2. Punches In
Date of execution: System normalizes punch time to company base timezone (or correctly offsets).
